prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit, commercial gym equipment preview. Image 1 is the ONLY edit target, a black GC-5002 Leg Extension machine on white. Preserve its exact camera, framing, aspect ratio, every mechanical shape and part. Images 2 and 3 are style references ONLY: use their exact dark rich forest green painted finish and italic white-and-green Full Muscle Equipment logo, not their machine or camera. Image 4 is a color-zone guide ONLY showing the same machine with red lever parts.
Modify image 1 only as follows: recolor its long diagonal painted steel shin-roller lever, its attached painted pivot plates and small connecting roller support into the dark green of references 2/3. The red regions of image 4 identify those painted surfaces. Keep bolts, pins and chrome ends silver; the large black cam cover remains black. Main frame, seat/back cushions, grips, rubber rollers, pulleys, cables, chrome guides, weight stack, labels, diagrams and instruction text remain exactly unchanged.
Branding: add the matching small italic Full Muscle Equipment logo centered on the upper horizontal black crossbar above the existing exercise instruction card. Reproduce the supplied logo style: white Full, green Muscle, tiny white EQUIPMENT underneath. Replace the existing vertical white TZFIT brand on the rear black panel behind the weight stack with the same Full Muscle logo rotated vertically to fit. Place the rear logo ON the panel, behind all chrome rods and behind the weight stack so physical occlusion is correct. Remove every remnant of TZFIT from that panel. Do not invent or alter exercise labels or weight numbers.
Retain pure opaque white background, existing shadows, crisp render quality and original composition. No extra equipment, no new parts, no warped geometry, no captions outside machine. Deliver one finished edited image, no collage.
qa: Preview visually checked: lever painted green, black frame/pads and chrome hardware retained, top brand added and rear brand replaced. Rear mark remains counterclockwise, opposite other previews, and largely obscured by the seat; retain sound machine geometry instead of failed logo correction. Fine text remains AI-rendered and needs prepublication review.
